issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: grass_block, allium, cornflower, stone_brick_wall, flowering_azalea_leaves, oxeye_daisy, dandelion, red_wall_banner, white_wall_banner, candle, red_wool, light_weighted_pressure_plate.
1 fence/pane/wall block(s) have no north/east/south/west set although a neighbour would connect, so they show as lone posts: (4, 6, 4).

notes.artefacts: Banners clip into the flowers below them; neck wall flagged as a lone post.
notes.materials: Peach white_terracotta head and torso clash with the grey stone; red cloak and gold crown are good accents.
notes.levels: Clearly new: gold crown, red wool cloak down his back, candles at his feet, banners on the posts.

visual.summary: Level 3: L2 plus a gold-look crown, a red cloak, candles at the king's feet and red/white banners on the lantern posts.
problems: The wall banners at (1,2,0), (7,2,0), (1,2,8), (7,2,8) hang down into the block below, right over the flowers at (1,1,0), (7,1,0), (1,1,8), (7,1,8): take those flowers out (or move the banners) so they don't clip.

The neck cobblestone_wall at (4,6,4) has no connections set although the red_wool cloak at (4,6,5) is next to it (automatic check); in game it will grow an arm to the cloak. Set south=low, or keep the thin neck by using a block that doesn't connect (e.g. a chain or end_rod).

Head (4,7,4) and torso (4,5,4) are white_terracotta, which renders peach and reads as bare skin on an otherwise stone statue ('the king in stone'): use a stone-like block (calcite, smooth_stone, polished_diorite) unless the clay look is wanted, and then say so in the description.
The raised sword (cobblestone_wall (5,7,4) + chain (5,8,4)) reads more like an antenna than a blade from the front; a lighter, sword-like top would help (e.g. iron_bars or an end_rod as the blade).
Reachability: open plaza piece, all paving and plinth steps are reached; only spots on the figure itself (shoulders, head) are not, which is fine.
